items.headline: Verstappen rules the Strip again
items.body: Max Verstappen won a wild Las Vegas Grand Prix under the lights Saturday night — his third Vegas win in four years — with the McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri rounding out the podium. George Russell was running strong before clipping the barriers late.
items.say: Did you catch the night race in Vegas? Verstappen just keeps winning on that Strip circuit.

items.headline: Nebraska stuns Ohio State — and ends the Buckeyes' playoff dream
items.body: In Lincoln, Nebraska pulled off the shocker of the weekend, beating No. 14 Ohio State 31-28 as Anthony Colandrea accounted for four touchdowns. It's the Huskers' first win over a ranked team in about a decade — and it knocks the Buckeyes out of the College Football Playoff picture.
items.say: Nebraska just took down Ohio State — did you see the Huskers knock the Buckeyes out of the playoff?

items.headline: Leeds crash the party at Stamford Bridge
items.body: Chelsea took an early lead through Emanuel Emegha, then completely fell apart: Leeds roared back 4-1 behind a Noah Okafor brace, a Dominic Calvert-Lewin penalty and a late Brenden Aaronson strike. It's Leeds' first win at Stamford Bridge since 1999 — and it bumps them up to sixth.
items.say: Leeds just won at Chelsea for the first time since 1999 — four goals at Stamford Bridge. Wild result.

items.headline: The rookies are the show — Boozer vs. Dybantsa
items.body: NBA Cup group play is heating up, and the two most-hyped rookies in years are delivering: Memphis's Cam Boozer and Washington's AJ Dybantsa are already stuffing stat sheets and trading big nights. It's the kind of rookie duel the league hasn't had in a while.
items.say: Have you seen these rookies — Cam Boozer and AJ Dybantsa? The NBA's got a real rookie rivalry brewing.

items.headline: 'Yellowjackets' begins the end
items.body: The fourth and final season of the twisty survival thriller landed on Paramount+ on Friday. The survivors are home, but the nightmare is far from over — expect the show to go all-in for its last run.
items.say: The final season of Yellowjackets just dropped — are you caught up, or did you bail after the wilderness got weird?

items.headline: A young Anthony Bourdain gets the A24 treatment
items.body: 'Tony,' A24's biopic about a 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain finding himself in a chaotic Provincetown kitchen in 1975, is making the rounds now with Dominic Sessa (The Holdovers) in the lead. A warm, nostalgic origin story for the late chef everyone loved.
items.say: There's an A24 movie about young Anthony Bourdain — the Holdovers kid plays him. Looks really good.

items.headline: Phoebe Bridgers keeps her holiday tradition going
items.body: Phoebe Bridgers dropped a hushed, pretty cover of Adrianne Lenker's 'Anything' — the latest in her annual holiday-single habit. Both artists are donating their proceeds to charity, so it's a feel-good one.
items.say: Phoebe Bridgers put out a new holiday song and she's giving the money to charity — perfect gloomy-cozy season track.

items.headline: 'Hunger Games' just set a franchise record
items.body: 'Sunrise on the Reaping' isn't just No. 1 — early numbers have it opening around $120 million, the biggest debut in Hunger Games history and Lionsgate's largest opening weekend in a decade. The odds were very much in its favor.
items.say: The new Hunger Games had the biggest opening in the whole franchise — like $120 million. People are still obsessed.
